# Junk Junkies Indiana

> Junk removal, cleanouts and light demolition in Indianapolis and surrounding Indiana cities. Phone/text: (317) 637-8807. Part of Junk Junkies (Texas HQ, Florida, Indiana).

## Services
- [Basement Cleanout](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/basement-cleanout-indianapolis/): Decades of storage, flooded contents and old furniture, carried up the stairs and gone in one visit.
- [Estate Cleanout](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/estate-cleanout-indianapolis/): Respectful, thorough cleanouts for families, attorneys and realtors on tight timelines.
- [Furniture Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/furniture-removal-indianapolis/): Couches, mattresses, dressers, tables and more, picked up and hauled away.
- [Appliance Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/appliance-removal-indianapolis/): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves and water heaters removed and disposed of properly.
- [Storm & Yard Debris](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/storm-debris-removal-indianapolis/): Downed limbs, ice-damaged fences and storm debris cleared after Central Indiana weather.
- [Shed, Deck & Light Demolition](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/shed-deck-demolition-indianapolis/): Sheds, decks, above-ground pools, hot tubs and playsets torn down and hauled in one visit.
- [Mattress Removal](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/mattress-removal-indianapolis/): Mattresses and box springs picked up from any room or floor and disposed of properly.
- [Property Management & Commercial](https://junkjunkiesindiana.com/property-management-junk-removal-indianapolis/): Apartment turns, eviction cleanouts, office cleanouts and construction debris for repeat clients.
